login.title: Sign in to {{name}}
login.subtitle: Use your Digital Wallet to securely access {{name}}.
login.mobile.instruction: Use your Digital Wallet to scan the QR code displayed on the {{name}} login page on your desktop, or paste the access code.
login.instructions.step1.title: Open your Digital Wallet
login.instructions.step1.desc: Open your EUDI Wallet or Digital Wallet on your device.
login.instructions.step2.title: Scan the QR code
login.instructions.step2.desc: Use your wallet to scan the QR code or paste the access code.
login.instructions.step3.title: Select your credential
login.instructions.step3.desc: Select the credential in your wallet to complete the authentication.
login.wallet.cta: Open Digital Wallet to sign in
login.wallet.hint: Then scan the QR code or paste the access code
login.errorCredentialRevoked: The credential has been revoked and is not valid for access.
login.methods.title: How do you want to identify yourself?
login.methods.x509.title: Digital certificate
login.methods.wallet.title: Attestation from your wallet
login.methods.levelNotice.high: This application requires a high level of assurance.
login.methods.levelNotice.substantial: This application requires a substantial level of assurance.
login.certificate.title: Sign in with your digital certificate
login.certificate.description: When you continue, your browser will ask you to choose your certificate. Use your personal certificate: DNIe, FNMT…
login.certificate.error.title: We could not use this certificate
login.certificate.reason.certificate_mis: You did not choose a certificate. To choose one, close the browser and start again.
login.certificate.reason.certificate_not: This certificate is not qualified. Use your DNIe or a recognised personal certificate.
This is a representative or seal certificate. You need your personal certificate. To choose another one, close the browser and start again.
login.certificate.reason.trust_validatio: We cannot check your certificate right now. Try again later or use another method.
login.certificate.reason.level_not_met: This application needs a certificate on a card or another secure device.
login.certificate.reason.login_not_found: The sign-in has expired. Go back to the application to start again.
